requirements.text: Dedicated in-person support for patients who may struggle with technology.
Clear instructions to guide patients in using the portal effectively.
Straightforward appointment booking with options for direct contact.
Online requests for repeat prescriptions while accommodating those who prefer phone requests.
Secure access to test results only after clinician review.
Verification mechanisms to confirm the identity of users before accessing personal information.
Compliance with regulations to ensure that all data handling practices meet legal requirements.
Strong safeguards against unauthorized access to prevent potential data breaches.
